famuse.why: Hypothetical layout (Claude, 11/19), kept for future reference; not an owner decision and not a current use. Governing rule, owner decision W8 (11/07): the family room is not a sleeping room until an escape window is installed. The layout uses the W7b and W8 provisions (wall-bed blocking, switched outlets, capped TV box). It stays part of the house with no cooking appliance: R-1-B allows one accessory apartment per lot, and the ADU is it. The hall door is conceptual only, not approved construction.

aduwin.why: Owner choice 11/22 for the ADU living window: an inside-mount, light-filtering, soft-textured roller shade rather than curtains, so the glass stays clear (about 6 in of wall to the west; the subpanel and the wall unit to the east). Floor-to-ceiling curtains stay the default elsewhere. Design layer (visual concept, not on the electrical or architectural plans).
aduwin.fix: Choose the product; measure the window opening (worksheet L-33).

adulayout.why: Layout test, visual only. F5 (ADU design record): a 78 in sofa about 12 in west to open the main path; owner preferred direction 11/22, not final. The table option puts a 30 in round table with two chairs in front of the chimney in place of the stools; the main entry-to-kitchen path is then about 34 in (36 in is the usual comfortable width), so it is not approved. The 3b option moves the seating to the peninsula south end: base about 32 in with a 12 in overhang, two stools facing north. The main path is then about 36 in, the same as tucking the west-side stools; the stool backs sit about 17 in from the chimney, two stools are tight on a 36 in end (about 24 in each is usual), and it changes the kitchen layout, so it would go to the architect and the cabinet plan. With the west-side stools in use the path is about 20 to 24 in in every layout. Model figures, about +/- 4 in. Design layer (visual concept, not on the electrical or architectural plans).
adulayout.source: Interior_Design_Review.md A6 and the option 3 test (11/22); ADU_Design_Record.md F5
adulayout.fix: Owner chooses between the south-end seating (3b) and tucked west-side stools; measure the room at the site visit.

adulight.why: Design concept, visual only: a surface-mounted ceiling reading spot over the sofa end in place of the staging floor lamp. Not on LP-2. Surface fastening on the 1-hour rated ceiling needs the architect's confirmation; a recessed fixture would need a detail that keeps the listed assembly. The studio's fixtures are not light sources, so it does not show real light levels; test the room at night before deciding (owner, 11/22). Design layer (visual concept, not on the electrical or architectural plans).
adulight.fix: Night check on site; the electrician picks the fixture; the architect confirms the ceiling fastening.

The kitchen window (shade or nothing) is still open and not shown. Design layer only: not on the electrical or architectural plans.
ffwin.source: Owner, 11/22; Interior_Design_Review_First_Floor.md (BT5, BD5, MB7, BR5, LV4); House_Decision_Register_2026-11-22.md
ffwin.fix: Choose products; measure each opening and sill in the field; confirm window operation and the escape openings stay clear.

llwin.why: Owner design directions 11/22: ADU bedroom, floor-to-ceiling blackout curtains with a sheer on both windows, on wall-mounted rods just under the rated ceiling (no ceiling track); family room, floor-to-ceiling curtains on both windows. Stack sides as modeled; the east-window stack is shown south of the window so it stays clear of the B3 media shelf. Design layer only.
llwin.fix: Choose products; measure the openings; keep the ADU bedroom escape window approach clear.
